sentences.text: On February 3, 2026, Quillfeather Urgent Care documented right ankle swelling after twisting on stairs and an X-ray negative for fracture.
On February 17, 2026, Dr. Orla Pennywhistle documented that ankle swelling improved and referred the patient to physical therapy 1x/week for 4 weeks.
On February 24, 2026, Pemberwick Physical Therapy documented, at visit 1, a mildly antalgic gait and pain of 4/10.
On March 3, 2026, Pemberwick Physical Therapy documented, at visit 2, pain of 3/10 and that balance exercises were added.
On March 10, 2026, Pemberwick Physical Therapy documented, at visit 3, pain of 2/10 and walking without a limp.
On March 17, 2026, Pemberwick Physical Therapy documented, at visit 4, pain of 1/10 and discharge to a home exercise program.
On March 25, 2026, Dr. Orla Pennywhistle documented a normal ankle exam and an optional recheck on 04/14/2026 if symptoms return.
